title: Evaluation of conventional imaging performance in a research whole-body CT system with a photon-counting detector array
version: Physics in Medicine and Biology 61(4), pp. 1572–1595. DOI 10.1088/0031-9155/61/4/1572.
lineage: Primary Mayo-led technical evaluation with Siemens collaborators. Dates are taken from the related operator and human-study sources rather than inferred from publication.

passages.note: Identifies the SOMATOM Definition Flash platform and two source-detector pairs using different detector types, one energy-integrating and one photon-counting.
passages.quote: with one x-ray source coupled to an EID and the other to a PCD
